text:
mira_csm: Kickoff: Suncrest pilot onboarding. Customer leads: Lina (product) + Mateo (platform). Aim: pilot embeddings + chat for support routing. Target: ~30 days.

owen_se: Quick infra Q — will they allow outbound to hosted endpoints from staging? that affects connector steps.

mira_csm: Lina says staging is fine; prod may need allowlist or VPC later. Recommend hosted for pilot speed.

rachel_enablement: I'll run enablement. Propose 2 short workshops: 1) Integration & runbook, 2) Prompting, evals & ops. Invite: product, infra, 1 support SME.

parker_successops: Renewal risk note: pilot budget small. Add escalation triggers: D12 <50% planned test traffic OR eval pass <78%. We'll do weekly traction email to Lina's exec.

owen_se: Tech checklist draft:
- API key exchange & IP allowlist steps
- anonymized sample transcripts (500–1k rows)
- golden-answer eval set + scoring rubric
- staging replay (5k) for p95 testing
- p95 latency goal: <350ms under typical load

mira_csm: Proposed timeline:
- D0 kickoff: stakeholder intro + goals
- D0–D7: env prep, keys, sample data handoff
- D8–D14: integration + smoke tests
- D15–D21: enablement workshops + eval runs
- D22–D30: pilot polish, exec traction, D30 decision (go/no-go)

rachel_enablement: I'll prep a 1-page pre-read and runbook template and share before workshop 1.

owen_se: I'll post a small test harness + curl examples tonight. can we get a 5k replay file?

onboard-bot: Meeting scheduled: "Suncrest Pilot Kickoff" on 2024-05-28 09:00 PDT — invites sent to mira_csm, owen_se, rachel_enablement, lina_suncrest.

mira_csm: Success criteria (please confirm):
- Integration completed with sample dataset
- >=78% correctness on agreed eval prompt set
- p95 latency <350ms in staging under replay
- Customer can run daily evals and receive regression alerts

parker_successops: Add: weekly traction report owner = parker_successops; D30 decision checkpoint = go/no-go + recommended commercial path (hosted vs Dedicated). I'll add D12 alert to dashboard.

mira_csm: Ownership roundup:
- Integration: owen_se
- Enablement & runbook: rachel_enablement
- Metrics & traction: parker_successops
- CSM: mira_csm

rachel_enablement: Action items: pre-read + runbook (by Mon), workshop slides (by D12).

owen_se: Action items: test harness + curl examples (EOD), request replay file.

parker_successops: Action items: weekly template + dashboard draft (Wed), wire D12 alert.

mira_csm: I'll finalize agenda and attendee list today and post notes after kickoff. Thanks team :raised_hands:
file_note: customer mentioned in text; participants list includes only Redwood staff and the onboard-bot per metadata rules
